title: Saudi-Style Crumble Oat Bites
description: A sweet and crunchy vegetarian treat using fermented and Saudi-inspired ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix together the fermented oats, Saudi dates, crumble, coconut oil, honey, vanilla extract, and salt.
Scoop the mixture into small balls and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
Serve as a snack or dessert.
